title: Accuracy Is Not Enough: A Deployment-Aware Benchmark of Algerian Dialect Sentiment Classifiers for CPU Inference (code, data splits and results)
description: Code, data splits and raw results of the paper: audit of three public Algerian sentiment datasets, a video-grouped YouTube split, training of three TF-IDF classifiers and four transformers, ONNX export and int8 quantisation evaluated over three training seeds, a CPU benchmark on two processors, and a decomposition of the TWIFIL scores. Code: MIT. TWIFIL-derived files: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; YouTube-derived files and results: CC BY 4.0; NArabizi-derived files: terms of the original release (see DATA_LICENSES.md).
